mintAuthority.summary: MXNB uses an upgradeable FiatToken fork. Existing Ethereum/Arbitrum reviews identify owner/masterMinter and proxy-admin EOAs. Arc block 25087646 independently confirms those same role addresses on Arc. Verified Arc source permits arbitrary minter allowances, implementation replacement and a hardcoded ownership-reset bypass; these are unbounded native issuance paths, not bridge mint controls.

controls.evidence: Sol curation campaign 2026-10-11 (L35MXNB): at Arc block 25087646, owner() and masterMinter() return this address; its eth_getCode result is 0x at the same pin, establishing no deployed runtime code at that block, not beneficial key custody. The verified implementation identified by the pinned implementation() read exposes configureMinter(address,uint256), onlyMasterMinter, with arbitrary allowance and no posted-backing gate. The same implementation hardcodes this address in superSetOwner(address), which directly calls setOwner without onlyOwner or a one-time initialization guard; ownership replacement can select a new masterMinter. This is unbounded native issuance authority, not a bridge mint path. No incident-free, multisig, financial reconciliation or process-certificate claim is made.

controls.capDescription: The proxy admin can replace native mint-critical implementation via upgradeTo or upgradeToAndCall, with no source-enforced mint bound.

controls.evidence: Sol curation campaign 2026-10-11 (L35MXNB): admin() returns this address at Arc block 25087646; its pinned eth_getCode returns 0x, establishing no deployed runtime code at that block but not beneficial key custody. Arc verified AdminUpgradeabilityProxy exposes upgradeTo(address) and upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) gated only by the admin address. An arbitrary replacement implementation can change native mint logic and bypass allowance constraints; no on-chain economic cap, timelock or independent approval is enforced in this path. The existing Ethereum/Arbitrum authorities are not used as evidence for Arc.

review.evidence: MXNB on Ethereum and Arbitrum is an upgradeable FiatToken-fork proxy. masterMinter() and owner() both resolve to EOA 0xcf3783...b739 on both chains. The proxy admin slot also resolves to an EOA 0x4d64a2...05ca. All confirmed via eth_call and eth_getCode at blocks 25295171 (ETH) and 472412264 (ARB). The same contract address 0xf197ffc... is used on all five listed chains. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): BDO Mexico, through Castillo Miranda y Compania, performs quarterly independent reserve reconciliation; the latest report covers 2026-03-31 and was published 2026-06-23. El Salvador CNAD's issuer registry exactly matches Nvio Pagos El Salvador, S.A. de C.V. as stablecoin issuer EME-0005, providing prudential issuer supervision. Re-verified at Ethereum block 25575167 on 2026-07-20: MXNB 0xf197ffc28c23e0309b5559e7a166f2c6164c80aa still returns owner() = masterMinter() = 0xCf3783ABaF4A11da1382F0c49748Fa87a1b6b739. This is a FiatTokenProxy using the legacy zeppelinos storage slots rather than EIP-1967: the implementation slot 0x7050c9e0…f8c3 resolves to 0x72beddf7032eec58f199857b79a8e37020c14e42 and the admin slot 0x10d6a54a…390b resolves to the EOA 0x4d64a2ccfed1a162c8b1d7a3d8fffeccab3305ca, while both EIP-1967 slots read zero. Economic-control adjudication: because the masterMinter EOA can configure any minter with an arbitrary allowance and the separate proxy-admin EOA can swap the implementation outright, with no multisig, timelock, or independent on-chain bound, the mint cap is economically unbounded even though CNAD registration and the quarterly BDO Mexico attestation constrain the issuer off-chain.
